subject: test(material/menu): enable exhaustive checks for all tests
reviewer: Codex primary implementer; independent audit remains separate

hunk_reviews.judgment: Removes the provideCheckNoChangesConfig import used by the private test override. The owned spec imports no such API, and no product import is needed.

Removes exhaustive:false from the private nested-menu TestBed providers. The owned menu/bootstrap has no corresponding provider to remove. Exact minimum Core source defaults false; no actual runtime/floor success is inferred.
Changes disabled sibling mutation from the menu item to the new secondItemDisabled fixture input binding. Preserve the owned disabled sibling API mutation, hover handler and one-panel assertion.
Changes disabled trigger mutation to the firstItemDisabled fixture field. Preserve the owned disabled trigger API mutation, hover handler and one-panel assertion.

Adds first/second disabled bindings to the two root NestedMenu buttons. Complete-file context identifies NestedMenu despite the Git hunk heading mentioning preceding CustomMenu. Keep the owned fixture template unchanged.
Adds the two false-valued fields to NestedMenu for those bindings. They are private exhaustive-test plumbing, not a change to disabled coercion or the public item API; no owned fields are required.

decision: The six original menu hunks remove a private exhaustive:false test provider and its import, move two disabled mutations from item instances to parent fixture fields, and add the two corresponding bindings and fields to NestedMenu. The same disabled-sibling/disabled-trigger hover regressions are present in the owned suite, so this is not an unreachable-menu exclusion. The retained spec/bootstrap has no exhaustive override, and authenticated exact Core21.2.23/22.1.7 runtime sources set the exhaustive-check default to false. That is a bounded static applicability argument, not an actual test-floor result. Keep both direct disabled API/hover assertions and the legacy fixture template; enabling upstream private exhaustive testing is not required for the retained runner. Do not adopt this private fixture rewrite or remove any assertion. Actual artifact disabled-hover, rendering and supported-floor checks remain required.
